title: A Noetherian ring is a G-ring if its maximal localizations have geometrically regular formal fibres
statement: Let $R$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] if and only if for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset R$ the local ring $R_{\mathfrak m}$ has geometrically regular formal fibres; equivalently, the completion map $R_{\mathfrak m}\to(R_{\mathfrak m})^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is regular in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] for every maximal $\mathfrak m$. This is More on Algebra Lemma Tag 07PT.
